theorems.statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (c : Covector (Euclid P) n ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (G : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (ε : ℝ), (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm α = ‖c α‖) → IsOpen V → Continuous G → HasCompactSupport G → tsupport G ⊆ V → 0 < ε → ∃ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, IsTestForm ω ∧ tsupport ω ⊆ V ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x - G x) ≤ ε
